limits: steady RANS (k-omega SST): natural-convection plumes really fluctuate
no radiation: passive cases are pessimistic (radiation can carry a third of the heat from a hot plate in still air)
isotropic solids: heat pipes are an effective conductivity, with no dry-out limit
obstacles (enclosure, boards) are adiabatic: the heat leaves only with the air
fans are actuator discs with a straight-line fan curve, no swirl

sources: Teertstra, Yovanovich, Culham, "Analytical forced convection modeling of plate fin heat sinks", SEMI-THERM 1999
Muzychka, Yovanovich, "Pressure drop in laminar developing flow in noncircular ducts", J. Fluids Eng. 2009 / ASME 2004
Song, Lee, Au, "Closed-form equation for thermal constriction/spreading resistances with variable resistance boundary condition", IEPS 1994
Kays & London, Compact Heat Exchangers (entrance/exit loss coefficients)
